behavior: On-demand actual catalog list/detail GET and exact manifest GET embedded in existing live workspace/detail. No preview fallback.
Reuse existing authenticated API/interceptors with text response and identity transform; no new token store or mutable endpoint.

Strict bounded UTF8/JSON parser rejects decoded duplicate keys, unknown closed fields, unsafe numeric bounds and noncanonical signed records. SHA uses original nested raw span and exact original manifest bytes, never parsed-object serialization.

Catalog joins installation/task/record ID and full signed-record SHA. Manifest joins independently read original catalog plus current detail manifest/index/marker/acceptance/catalog hashes and capture hash.

Displayed state binds installation/task/hash/RV AND reader identity AND a fresh context epoch. Reader change hides prior ready content immediately; changing back cannot resurrect it. Request callbacks check latest context and active AbortController; cleanup cancels old work.
UI explicitly describes original-byte digest checks, server signature verification and no independent client signature verification or grant of DR eligibility.

validation.static: Tracked diff whitespace inspected; root must run syntax/type/unit validation
commands: From frontend: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit --incremental false
From frontend: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js [seven changed TS/TSX files]
validation.artifacts: Tests transpile in memory; tsc noEmit and nonincremental; eslint without cache. No test/build outputs generated.
validation.testLimits: Component behavior uses compiled actual component event logic with explicit hook-state/effect harness plus React server rendering. Not a browser/layout or authenticated real-page execution proof. Root should additionally verify actual browser behavior on the authorized live installation.

rootRequiredBrowserChecks: Authorized catalog/manifest read from actual original succeeded task; original byte digest and complete refs agree.
Switch task, installation, reader or authorization context during and after success; prior content disappears and late promise cannot write.
401/403/503, non-live response, changed record/hash/version and corruption show no new success or preview substitution.
No create/purpose/terminal/restore mutation triggered by these read controls.
